arXiv:2604.24697v1 [cs.AI] 2026 年 4 月 27 日arXiv:2604.24697v1 [cs.AI] 27 Apr 2026

当前的代理可以缩小发现到应用程序的差距吗？ 《我的世界》案例研究Can Current Agents Close the Discovery-to-Application Gap? A Case Study in Minecraft

Zhou Ziheng1∗ Huacong Tang1∗ Jinyuan Zhang1 Haowei Lin2 Bangcheng Yang1
Qian Long3 Fang Sun1 Yizhou Sun1 Yitao Liang2 Ying Nian Wu1
Demetri Terzopoulos1 Xiaofeng Gao3
1University of California, Los Angeles  2Peking University  3Amazon
∗Equal contribution. josephziheng@ucla.edu, hctang@ucla.edu
 Project Page    Code
摘要Abstract

发现因果规律并将其应用于构建功能系统（发现到应用循环）是通用智能的标志，但评估这种能力却因科学发现与现实世界工程之间巨大的复杂性差距而受到阻碍。我们介绍Discovering causal regularities and applying them to build functional systems—the discovery-to-application loop—is a hallmark of general intelligence, yet evaluating this capacity has been hindered by the vast complexity gap between scientific discovery and real-world engineering. We introduce科幻大师SciCrafter，一个基于 Minecraft 的基准测试，通过参数化的红石电路任务来操作该循环。特工必须以指定的模式点燃灯（例如，同时或按时间顺序）；缩放目标参数大大增加了构建的复杂性和所需的知识，迫使真正的发现而不是依赖于记忆的解决方案。在通用代码代理支架下评估包括 GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro 和 Claude-Opus-4.5 在内的前沿模型，我们发现所有模型的成功率均稳定在大约 26% 左右。为了诊断这些失败，我们将循环分解为四种能力——知识差距识别、实验发现、知识巩固和知识应用——并设计有针对性的干预措施，其边际贡献作为相应差距的代理。我们的分析表明，虽然通用知识应用能力仍然是所有模型中最大的差距，但对于前沿模型来说，知识差距识别开始成为主要障碍，表明瓶颈正在从, a Minecraft-based benchmark that operationalizes this loop through parameterized redstone circuit tasks. Agents must ignite lamps in specified patterns (e.g., simultaneously or in timed sequences); scaling target parameters substantially increases construction complexity and required knowledge, forcing genuine discovery rather than reliance on memorized solutions. Evaluating frontier models including GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.5 under a general-purpose code agent scaffold, we find that all plateau at approximately 26% success rate. To diagnose these failures, we decompose the loop into four capacities—knowledge gap identification, experimental discovery, knowledge consolidation, and knowledge application—and design targeted interventions whose marginal contributions serve as proxies for corresponding gaps. Our analysis reveals that although the general knowledge application capability still remains as the biggest gap across all models, for frontier models the knowledge gap identification starts to become a major hurdle—indicating the bottleneck is shifting from正确解决问题solving problems right to 提出正确的问题raising the right problems对于当前的人工智能。我们发布for current AI. We release科幻大师SciCrafter作为未来人工智能系统研究的诊断探针，引导整个发现到应用循环。as a diagnostic probe for future research on AI systems that navigate the full discovery-to-application loop.

1 简介Introduction

在人类社会中，发现（例如科学）和应用（例如工程）之间的相互作用形成了一个推动技术进步的自我进化循环。科学研究揭示了世界如何运转的因果模型In human society, the interplay between discovery (e.g., science) and application (e.g., engineering) forms a self-evolving loop that drives technological advancement. Scientific investigations uncover causal models of how the world works(Pearl, 2009; Newell & Simon, 1976; Gupta et al., 2024)，为工程构建复杂系统提供知识, providing knowledge for engineering to build complex systems(Simon, 1996)，而工程挑战反过来又引发了新的科学探究。这种导航发现到应用循环的能力是通用智能的标志, while engineering challenges in turn spark new scientific inquiries. This capacity to navigate the discovery-to-application loop is a hallmark of general intelligence(Lake et al., 2017; Tenenbaum et al., 2011; Gopnik & Wellman, 2012; Goodman et al., 2008)。事实上，人类学证据甚至表明这些相互交织的过程在人类认知本身的进化中发挥了关键作用. Indeed, anthropological evidence even suggests these intertwined processes played a pivotal role in the evolution of human cognition itself(Stout, 2011; Malafouris, 2021; Vaesen, 2012; Lombard & Högberg, 2021).

评估发现到应用循环的一个关键障碍是“复杂性差距”，即确定科学原理和设计实际应用之间在时间尺度和资源上的巨大差异。现代科学技术的发展历程跨越数年，物理实验需要复杂的机器人操作，但这一问题仍未得到解决。A key barrier to evaluating the discovery-to-application loop is the “complexity gap”—the vast disparity in timescale and resources between identifying a scientific principle and engineering a real-world application. Modern science-to-technology pipelines span years, and physical experiments require sophisticated robotic manipulation that remains unsolved.

《我的世界》提供了一个理想的替代品来弥补这一差距。作为一个具有丰富空间、因果和时间动态的持久 3D 世界，它支持高度复杂系统（直至功能齐全的 CPU）的开放式构建。Minecraft offers an ideal surrogate that bridges this gap. As a persistent 3D world with rich spatial, causal, and temporal dynamics, it supports open-ended construction of highly complex systems—up to fully functional CPUs.111https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Tutorials/Redstone_computers至关重要的是，虽然基本的游戏机制广为人知，但法学硕士很难准确捕捉到精确的低级细节，例如不同游戏版本之间不同的信号干扰模式和结构约束。因此，代理人不能仅仅依靠先验知识；他们必须发现这些隐藏的动态才能构建功能设备。通过将物理操作抽象为离散的基于块的交互，《我的世界》将科学探究和工程设计的核心认知过程与机器人的限制隔离开来。此外，可以通过编程方式修改环境规则，防止智能体简单地记住解决方案并强制真正参与发现循环。Crucially, while basic game mechanics are widely known, precise low-level details—such as signal interference patterns and structural constraints that vary across game editions—are difficult for LLMs to capture accurately. Agents therefore cannot rely solely on prior knowledge; they must discover these hidden dynamics to build functional devices. By abstracting physical manipulation into discrete block-based interactions, Minecraft isolates the core cognitive processes of scientific inquiry and engineering design from robotic limitations. Furthermore, the environment’s rules can be programmatically modified, preventing agents from simply memorizing solutions and forcing genuine engagement with the discovery loop.

这种设置使我们能够研究两个基本问题：This setting allows us to investigate two fundamental questions:(1) 当前的人工智能代理能否自主导航整个发现到应用的循环——如果不能，差距在哪里？ (2) 哪些认知能力构成主要瓶颈？(1) Can current AI agents autonomously navigate the full discovery-to-application loop—and if not, where is the gap? (2) Which cognitive capacities constitute the primary bottlenecks?为了解决这些问题，我们引入To address these questions, we introduce科幻大师SciCrafter，一个任务套件，可以以可扩展的复杂性来操作和评估这些能力。, a task suite that operationalizes and evaluates these capacities with scalable complexity.

任务模式故意简单：igniteThe task schema is intentionally simple: igniteNN以指定模式（例如，同时或遵循延迟序列）的灯lamps in specified patterns (e.g., simultaneously, or following a delay sequence[t1,t2,…,tn][t_{1},t_{2},\ldots,t_{n}]）在固定区域内（见图) within a fixed area (see Figure2）。这种设计确保评估在不同难度级别上保持不变（通过单独调整目标参数来扩展复杂性），同时构建复杂性和所需知识大幅增长。例如，通过基本布线可以成功同步四个灯，但扩展到八个需要发现“嵌套集线器”模式。从 32 盏灯进一步扩展到 64 盏灯需要了解信号衰减以及中继器如何规避信号衰减。). This design ensures evaluation remains invariant across difficulty levels—complexity scales by adjusting target parameters alone—while construction complexity and required knowledge grow substantially. For instance, synchronizing four lamps may succeed with basic wiring, but scaling to eight requires discovering the “nested hub” pattern. Scaling further from 32 to 64 lamps demands understanding signal degradation and how repeaters circumvent it.

我们设计了五种任务变体：(1) 同时点火，(2) 分支到达（T 形接头扩展），(3) 顺序We design five task variations: (1) Simultaneous Ignition, (2) Branch Reach (T-Junction Expansion), (3) SequentialNN-阶段激活，(4) 等延迟分布，以及 (5) 脉冲扩展。每个变体都包括五个手动校准的难度级别，并平衡知识差距，尽管用户可以配置任意难度设置。-Stage Activation, (4) Equal-Delay Distribution, and (5) Pulse Extension. Each variation includes five manually calibrated difficulty levels with balanced knowledge gaps, though users can configure arbitrary difficulty settings.

为了评估现代人工智能如何驾驭这一从发现到应用的循环，我们评估了一套最先进的模型，包括前沿推理模型，例如 GPT-5.2、Gemini-3-Pro 和 Claude-Opus-4.5 到流行的小型开源模型（例如 Qwen3-32B）。所有型号均配备通用编码剂支架 （Claude Code）提供标准化的线束。我们选择这种设置的原因有三个： 简单的法学硕士缺乏复杂的工具使用和内存能力。 像我们这样的任务；手动设计的支架（自定义内存结构、工作流程等）引入了混杂变量，导致难以绘制稳定的模型 结论；编码代理支架广泛用于一般代理任务，使它们成为当前 LLM 能力的合理代理——尽管不是上层代理任务 限制了当前人工智能所能实现的目标。在此设置下，所有代理的成功率稳定在大约 26% 左右（To assess how modern AI navigates this discovery-to-application loop, we evaluated a suite of state-of-the-art models, ranging from frontier reasoning models such as GPT-5.2, Gemini-3-Pro, and Claude-Opus-4.5 to popular small open-source models such as Qwen3-32B. All models were equipped with a general-purpose coding agent scaffold (Claude Code) to provide a standardized harness. We chose this setup for three reasons: bare-bone LLMs lack the tool use and memory capabilities required for a complex task like ours; manually engineered scaffolds (custom memory structures, workflows, etc.) introduce confounding variables that make it difficult to draw stable conclusions; and coding agent scaffolds are widely adopted for general agentic tasks, making them a reasonable proxy for current LLM capability — though not an upper bound on what current AI can achieve. Under this setup, all agents plateau at approximately 26% success rate (Figure˜1).

为了诊断导致此故障的性能瓶颈，我们将发现到应用程序循环分解为四个不同的功能：(1)To diagnose the performance bottlenecks responsible for this failure, we decompose the discovery-to-application loop into four distinct capacities: (1)知识差距识别Knowledge Gap Identification——识别知识差距并制定有针对性的研究问题的能力； (2)—the ability to identify knowledge gaps and formulate targeted research questions; (2)实验发现Experimental Discovery——设计和执行严格实验以推断不可观察的因果机制的能力； (3)—the capacity to design and execute rigorous experiments to infer unobservable causal mechanisms; (3)知识巩固Knowledge Consolidation——将研究结果提炼成简洁、可重复使用的形式以供将来应用的能力；和（4）—the ability to distill findings into concise, reusable forms for future application; and (4)知识应用Knowledge Application——推理、计划和执行精确工程的基本能力，定义为上述未涵盖的剩余能力。—the foundational ability to reason, plan, and execute precise engineering, defined as the residual capacity not covered by the above.

为了隔离每种能力，我们设计了一系列“预言”干预措施，其边际贡献可作为相应能力差距的代理。对于知识差距识别，我们提供手工制作的提示，指示缺失知识的区域（例如“信号流方向”），而无需透露细节——模型知道To isolate each capacity, we devise a series of “oracle” interventions whose marginal contributions serve as proxies for the corresponding capacity gaps. For knowledge gap identification, we provide manually crafted hints indicating areas of missing knowledge (e.g., “signal flow direction”) without revealing specifics—models know什么what发现但不是答案。对于实验发现，我们引入了“科学家”子代理来指导更严格的调查。为了巩固知识，我们设计了结构化的知识输入格式。设计细节见章节to discover but not the answer. For experimental discovery, we introduce a “scientist” sub-agent to guide more rigorous investigation. For knowledge consolidation, we design a structured knowledge entry format. The design details are in Section4。请注意，这些代理和合并设计同时是代理方法的贡献。根据定义，剩余的差距归因于知识应用。. Note that these agent and consolidation designs are simultaneously contributions of agent methods. The remaining gap is attributed to knowledge application by definition.

我们的分析表明，一般知识应用目前仍然是所有模型的主要差距，但对于前沿模型来说，知识差距识别开始占据主导地位。我们的“科学家”子代理和合并方法的收益率为 0.33–1.00Our analysis reveals that the general knowledge application is still currently the major gap for all models, but for frontier models the knowledge gap identification start to gain dominance. Also our “scientist” sub-agent and consolidation methods yield 0.33–1.00×\times相对收益，揭示了实验发现中尚未开发的巨大潜力。relative gains, revealing significant untapped potential in experimental discovery.

总之，我们的贡献有三方面：In summary, our contributions are three-fold:

  1. 1.

    我们构建We construct科幻大师SciCrafter，Minecraft 中的一组从发现到应用程序循环的任务，具有自动可扩展的难度。, a set of discovery-to-application-loop tasks in Minecraft with automatically scalable difficulty.

  2. 2.

    我们将这个循环中法学硕士的能力差距分解为四个部分，并评估当前的各种语言模型。We decompose the capacity gap of LLMs in this loop into four components and evaluate a wide range of current language models.

  3. 3.

    我们贡献了一个“科学家”子智能体和一种知识整合方法，可以显着提高智能体的发现能力。We contribute a “scientist” sub-agent and a knowledge consolidation method that significantly improve an agent’s discovery ability.

3 任务构建Task Construction

高级任务架构High Level Task Schema

我们设计We design科幻大师SciCrafter牢记两个原则：with two principles in mind:系统课程systematic curriculum在知识差距和in knowledge gaps and自动可扩展性automated scalability。任务必须构成需要真正发现的结构化知识差距序列，并且任务复杂性必须自动扩展，而无需手动重新设计每个难度级别。. Tasks must pose a structured sequence of knowledge gaps that require genuine discovery, and task complexity must scale automatically without manual redesign of each difficulty level.

为了满足这些需求，我们采用了一个简单但富有表现力的任务模式：igniteTo satisfy these desiderata, we adopt a simple yet expressive task schema: igniteNN以指定模式（例如，同时或遵循延迟序列）的灯lamps in specified patterns (e.g., simultaneously, or following a delay sequence[t1,t2,…,tn][t_{1},t_{2},\ldots,t_{n}]）在固定区域内。这种设计确保评估在不同难度级别上保持不变，而满足要求的知识差距不断扩大，需要发现新的环境机制。例如，代理可以成功地将四个灯与基本接线同步，但扩展到八个需要发现“嵌套集线器”模式；从 32 盏灯进一步扩展到 64 盏灯需要了解信号衰减以及中继器如何规避信号衰减（见图) within a fixed area. This design ensures that evaluation remains invariant across difficulty levels, while the knowledge gap to meet the requirements consistently grow, necessitating the discovery of new environmental mechanics. For instance, an agent may successfully synchronize four lamps with basic wiring, but scaling to eight requires discovering the “nested hub” pattern; scaling further from 32 to 64 lamps demands understanding signal degradation and how repeaters can circumvent it (see Figure2).

任务族和知识差距Task Families and Knowledge Gaps

我们设计了五个任务系列来探测不同的空间和时间约束：We design five task families that probe distinct spatial and temporal constraints:(A) 同时点火(A) Simultaneous Ignition—激活—activateNN灯同时滴答作响；lamps at the same tick;(B) T 字路口路线(B) T-Junction Routing—使用主干和分支布局连接灯具；—connect lamps using a trunk-and-branch layout;(C) 顺序激活(C) Sequential Activation— 以指定的级间延迟激活灯—activate lamps with specified inter-stage delays[t1,t2,…,tn][t_{1},t_{2},\ldots,t_{n}]; (D) 距离均衡点火(D) Distance-Equalized Ignition—同时激活放置在不同距离的灯；和—simultaneously activate lamps placed at heterogeneous distances; and(E) 脉冲扩展(E) Pulse Extension— 在指定时间内保持激活—maintain activation for a specified durationτ\tau。 详情见附录. Details are provided in AppendixC.

至关重要的是，难度不会随着任务参数（例如，Crucially, difficulty does not increase smoothly with task parameters (e.g.,NN在家庭 A) 中；相反，更高的层次交叉离散in Family A); instead, higher levels cross discrete机制阈值mechanism thresholds这需要发现新的红石原理。我们确定了三个核心知识维度。第一个是that require discovering new redstone principles. We identify three core knowledge dimensions. The first is局部连线语法local wiring grammar：灰尘仅通过轴对齐的邻接传播（无对角线传导），自动连接到邻居（创建意外的分支），并且必须物理接触灯才能为其供电；按钮为其支撑块提供强大的动力，因此省略该块会产生看似合理但不起作用的电路。第二个是: dust propagates only through axis-aligned adjacency (no diagonal conduction), auto-connects to neighbors (creating unintended branches), and must physically contact a lamp to power it; a button strongly powers its supporting block, so omitting the block yields a plausible but non-functional circuit. The second is衰减感知拓扑attenuation-aware topology：灰尘承载着力量: dust carries strength∈{0,…,15}\in\{0,\ldots,15\}每块衰减 1，并在 15 段后消失，迫使集线器/主干设计或显式再生以获得更大的足迹。第三个是that decays by one per block and vanishes after 15 segments, forcing hub/backbone designs or explicit regeneration for larger footprints. The third is转发器语义repeater semantics：中继器可再生信号至全强度，但充当定向二极管，具有 1-4 个刻度延迟；这种延迟会在链上累积，使时序偏差成为首要约束，并且侧电源可能会意外锁定中继器。: repeaters regenerate signal to full strength but act as directional diodes with 1–4 ticks latency; this latency accumulates over chains, making timing skew a first-class constraint, and side power can lock repeaters unexpectedly.

每个家庭都存在不同的知识差距。对于 A 系列：早期级别允许对称分支，中期需要在衰减预算内更密集的拓扑，而高级则强制中继器插入并进行联合延迟距离平衡（见图Each family surfaces different knowledge gaps. For Family A : early levels admit symmetric branching, mid levels require denser topologies within the attenuation budget, and high levels force repeater insertion with joint delay-distance balancing (see Figure2）。 B 系列强制采用 T 形接头布局，将问题转化为拓扑约束路由。系列 C 需要将量化的中继器延迟组成精确的延迟线。系列 D 要求使用中继器作为补偿延迟元件来均衡异构路径长度。 E 系列增加了需要脉冲整形技术的持续时间限制。). Family B enforces T-junction layouts, turning the problem into topology-constrained routing. Family C requires composing quantized repeater delays into precise delay lines. Family D demands using repeaters as compensatory delay elements to equalize heterogeneous path lengths. Family E adds duration constraints requiring pulse-shaping techniques.

4 科学家Scientist子代理和知识整合Sub-agent And Knowledge Consolidation

正如简介中提到的，我们提供了一种“科学家”子代理方法，以方便评估并作为通用方法贡献。子代理充当主代理通过实验发现新知识的一种方式。每当主代理认为它遇到了需要填补的知识空白时，它只会提示子代理一个需要调查的问题 - 实例，As mentioned in the introduction, we provided a “scientist” sub-agent method to both facilitate the evaluation and as a general method contribution. The sub-agent serves as a way for the main agent to discover new knowledge through experimentation. Every time the main agent believes it encounters a knowledge gap to fill, it simply prompts the sub-agent with a question to investigate—for instance,“石头按钮按下后要持续多长时间？ 激活？”“How long does a stone button remain pressed after activation?”然后科学家子代理将不再依赖先前的假设，而是进行系统的控制实验来找出答案。完成后，它会更新与主代理共享的知识书。然后，主代理可以使用精炼的知识重新尝试构建任务，并向子代理提出新问题。And then the scientist sub-agent will not rely on prior assumptions, but instead conduct systematic control experiments to find out. When it finishes, it updates the knowledge book shared with the main agent. The main agent can then reattempt the construction task using the refined knowledge, and prompt new questions to the sub-agent.

4.1 科学家Scientist子代理设计Sub-agent Design

科学家代理的主要设计是为其提供一个进行实验的模板和一个提取知识的模板作为系统提示（完整的提示和模板见附录）The major design for the scientist agent is providing it with a template for conducting experiments and a template for extracting knowledge as the system prompt (full prompts and templates are in AppendixG）。除此之外，还提供了当前的知识书籍、过去实验报告的历史以及在线的 Minecraft 基本 wiki。). Along with them, it is also provided with the current knowledge book, the history of past experiment reports, and a basic wiki of Minecraft from online.

该科学实验模板设计借鉴了AI科学家的作品This scientific experiment template design is drawn upon AI Scientists line of works(Lu et al., 2025; Jansen et al., 2024; Elahi et al., 2024)。本质就是提出假设、设计实验、分析结果、迭代。我们将它们分为八个具体部分：(1). The essence is to formulate hypothesis, design experiments, analyze results and iterate. We break them down to eight specific parts: (1)研究问题Research Question——确定接受调查的具体机械师； (2)—identify the specific mechanic under investigation; (2)假设Hypothesis——制定可检验的预测； (3)—formulate a testable prediction; (3)实验设计Experiment Design——指定自变量、测量目标和控制； (4)—specify the independent variable, measurement target, and controls; (4)实验步骤Experiment Steps——描述执行每项试验的程序； (5)—describe procedures to execute each trial; (5)实验记录Experiment Record——记录观察结果并注意假设的一致性； (6)—document observations and note hypothesis alignment; (6)实验结果Experiment Results——总结经验结果； (7)—summarize empirical outcomes; (7)分析总结Analysis & Summary——解释模式并评估假设；和（8）—interpret patterns and evaluate the hypothesis; and (8)下一步Next Steps——提出后续实验来完善所发现的定律。此工作流作为基本代码代理的系统提示替换提供，而不是作为严格的执行脚本强制执行。该系统利用法学硕士和代码代理的一般能力来遵循结构，同时允许每个步骤的执行方式具有灵活性。请注意，我们要求科学家代理将每个实验重复三次，以确保结果可靠。—propose follow-up experiments to refine the discovered law. This workflow is provided as a system prompt replacement of the base code agent rather than enforced as a rigid execution script. The system leverages the LLM and code agent’s general capability to follow the structure while allowing flexibility in how each step is executed. Note that we asked the scientist agent to repeat each experiment three times to ensure reliable results.

这个由八部分组成的结构还可以作为科学家代理在每次实验迭代后必须完成的书面实验报告的模板。 完成一组实验后，将创建并存档实验报告以供将来参考。然后，基于这个新的实验报告，结合完整的实验历史和知识书中现有的条目，科学家代理用新的发现更新知识书。This eight-part structure also serves as the template for the written experiment report that the scientist agent must complete after each experimental iteration. Upon finishing one set of experiments, an experiment report is created and archived for future reference. Then, based on this new experiment report, combining the complete experiment history and the existing entries in the knowledge book, the scientist agent updates the knowledge book with the new finding.

4.2 知识整合结构Knowledge Consolidation Structure

实验结束后，科学家代理将其发现整合到知识书中。我们发现这种结构对于以后的性能至关重要（见表After the experiments, the scientist agent consolidates its findings into the knowledge book. We find this structure is critical for later performance (see Table2）。最终设计由四部分组成，包括：). The final design is a four-part structure comprising:

  1. 1.

    索赔（法律）：Claim (law):发现的定律或动力学陈述。The discovered law or dynamics statement.

  2. 2.

    证据证明：Evidence Proof:基于实验的证明。The proof based on experiments.

  3. 3.

    限制条件：Constraints:既定法律的适用限制。The constraints of application for the found law.

  4. 4.

    示例：Example:如何应用它的实际示例。A practical example of how to apply it.

知识书中的一个说法是“每移动一段距离，红石信号强度就会减少 1”。查看提示请参见附录A claim in the knowledge book is like “Redstone signal strength decreases by 1 for every block of distance traveled”. To see the prompt, please see AppendixH了解详情。请注意，我们发现知识书结构对最终性能的影响非常大。请参阅后面部分的消融实验。for details. Note that we find that the knowledge book structure affects the final performance non-trivially. Please see the ablation experiment in later section.

在每次发现迭代时At each discovery iterationkk，科学家代理进行查询, the scientist agent takes a queryQkQ_{k}，进行实验轨迹，生成实验报告, conducts an experiment trajectory, generates an experiment reportE​RkER_{k}，并更新知识书, and updates the knowledge bookK​BkKB_{k}逐渐地。这确保了科学家不断发展的理解在每次迭代结束时都能得到实时反映。正式的映射在附录中提供incrementally. 5 实验Experiments

5.1 实验设计方法Experiment Design Method

为了诊断发现到应用循环中的能力差距，我们将过程分解为基于常见科学和工程实践的四个步骤： (1) 知识差距识别——认识到需要发现什么； (2)通过实验发现知识——进行系统的实验来收集 证据、验证假设并完善理解； (3) 知识整合——以可重复使用的形式呈现和保存研究结果； (4) 残差，其中 我们称之为知识应用——理解、推理和应用现有知识的一般能力。我们承认这不是唯一有效的 分解。人们还可以通过时空推理、长情境管理或其他构成能力的视角来分析能力差距。 在这里，我们重点关注与发现到应用程序本身一致的分解。To diagnose the capability gap within the discovery-to-application loop, we decompose the procedure into four steps grounded in common science and engineering practice: (1) knowledge gap identification — recognizing what needs to be discovered; (2) knowledge discovery through experiments — conducting systematic experiments to collect evidence, verify hypotheses, and refine understanding; (3) knowledge consolidation — presenting and preserving findings in a reusable form; and (4) the residual, which we term knowledge application — the general capacity to understand, reason about, and apply existing knowledge. We acknowledge that this is not the only valid decomposition. One could alternatively analyze capability gaps through the lens of spatiotemporal reasoning, long-context management, or other constituent abilities. Here, we focus on a decomposition aligned with the discovery-to-application procedure itself.

为了量化这些差距，我们使用To quantify these gaps, we use the边际贡献marginal contribution有针对性的脚手架干预措施作为代理。由于每次干预同时提供帮助并改变代理行为（例如，提示也可以充当表示需要探索的元认知线索），因此测量到的差距反映了干预的联合效果和模型对其的响应，而不是干净地隔离单个潜在能力。of targeted scaffolding interventions as proxies. Because each intervention simultaneously provides assistance and alters agent behavior (e.g., hints may also serve as metacognitive cues signaling that exploration is needed), the measured gaps reflect the joint effect of the intervention and the model’s response to it, rather than cleanly isolating a single latent capacity.

对于知识识别阶段，我们提供高级预言提示（例如“信号流方向”），引导模型进入相关的研究领域，而无需指定底层机制。这使我们能够将模型识别差距的能力与发现差距的能力分开。For the knowledge identification stage, we provide high-level oracle hints (e.g., ‘signal flow direction’) that guide the model toward the relevant area of investigation without specifying the underlying mechanisms. This allows us to separate the model’s ability to identify a gap from its ability to discover it.

的The科学家scientist子代理和知识整合方法在章节中详细介绍sub-agent and knowledge consolidation methods are detailed in Sections4.1和and4.2。值得注意的是，子代理需要一个整合机制来将发现转发给主代理，从而排除对发现能力的完全隔离评估。由于合并过滤和组织信息而不是生成信息，因此合并方法充当子代理效率的上限。因此，在测量发现能力差距时，我们将子代理与优化的整合方法配对，从而更准确地估计每个模型的内在发现潜力。. Notably, the sub-agent requires a consolidation mechanism to relay discoveries to the primary agent, precluding fully isolated evaluation of discovery capacity. Since consolidation filters and organizes information rather than generating it, the consolidation method acts as an upper bound on the sub-agent’s efficacy. We therefore pair the sub-agent with our optimized consolidation method when measuring the discovery capacity gap, providing a more accurate estimate of each model’s intrinsic discovery potential.

我们将模型的性能形式化We formalize the performance of a modelMM作为成功概率as the success probabilityP​(S=1∣M,𝒜)P(S{=}1\mid M,\mathcal{A}), 其中, where𝒜\mathcal{A}是一组上下文帮助。我们将四个差距定义为依次引入每种干预措施的边际收益：(1)is a set of contextual assistances. We define four gaps as the marginal gains from sequentially introducing each intervention: (1)知识识别差距Knowledge Identification Gap (δi​d\delta_{id})：通过在无辅助基线上提供预言机提示而获得的收益； (2)): the gain from providing oracle hints over the unassisted baseline; (2)知识发现差距Knowledge Discovery Gap (δd​s\delta_{ds})：引入经过优化整合的科学家子代理所带来的额外收益； (3)): the additional gain from introducing the scientist sub-agent with optimized consolidation; (3)整合优化差距Consolidation Optimization Gap (δk​c\delta_{kc})：切换到结构化合并模板的收益；和（4）): the gain from switching to a structured consolidation template; and (4)应用差距Application Gap (δa​p​p\delta_{app}）：与完美性能的剩余差距，代表我们的干预措施无法直接解决的基础能力，例如空间推理和代码生成。这四个差距与基线成功率一起将总容量空间划分为 100%。我们还报告了): the residual gap to perfect performance, representing foundational capabilities such as spatial reasoning and code generation that our interventions do not directly address. These four gaps, together with the baseline success rate, partition the total capacity space to 100%. We also report the相对间隙比relative gap ratio rδ=δ/P​(S=1∣M,∅)r_{\delta}=\delta/P(S{=}1\mid M,\emptyset)对具有不同基线的模型进行标准化。正式定义见附录to normalize across models with different baselines. 我们使用 Claude 代码评估各种 LLM 套件：GPT-5.2、Claude-Opus-4.5、Gemini-3-Pro、Grok-4、GLM-4.7、Qwen3-235B-MoE、Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-32BWe evaluate a diverse suite of LLMs—GPT-5.2, Claude-Opus-4.5, Gemini-3-Pro, Grok-4, GLM-4.7, Qwen3-235B-MoE, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, and Qwen3-32B—using Claude Code(Anthropic, 2025)，一个最先进的代码代理框架。每个模型的预算为每项任务 50 次验证试验，并在课程设置中进行评估（L1, a state-of-the-art code agent framework. 6 结果与讨论Results and Discussion

6.1 基准性能Baseline Performance

表Table1总结所有模型的结果。最好的模型 Gemini-3-Pro 只取得了 26.0% 的成功率，尽管参数数量从 72B 到 Grok-4 的估计 1.7 万亿不等，但所有前沿模型都稳定在这个水平附近。这表明仅扩展模型大小并不能解决发现到应用循环中的基本瓶颈。summarizes results across all models. The best model, Gemini-3-Pro, achieves only 26.0% success, with all frontier models plateauing near this level despite parameter counts ranging from 72B to an estimated 1.7 trillion for Grok-4. This suggests that scaling model size alone does not resolve the fundamental bottlenecks in the discovery-to-application loop.

6.2 诊断绩效差距Diagnosing Performance Gaps

我们使用有针对性的脚手架干预措施进行系统消融（表We conducted systematic ablations using targeted scaffolding interventions (Table1）。如节中所述). As noted in Section5.1，这些干预措施充当代理；衡量的差距反映了每种援助形式的边际效益。, these interventions serve as proxies; the measured gaps reflect the marginal benefit of each form of assistance.

知识差距识别。Knowledge Gap Identification.Oracle 提示（例如“信号衰减比”）在不透露解决方案的情况下指导发现，产生了最大的单一改进：所有模型的成功率大致翻倍，绝对增益为 15.0-27.0%。Oracle hints (e.g., “signal decay ratio”) that guide discovery without revealing solutions yield the largest single improvement: all models roughly double their success rate, with absolute gains of 15.0–27.0%.

实验发现。Experimental Discovery.添加具有优化知识整合的“科学家”子代理可在所有级别上进一步提高 7.5-14.0% 的绝对值，使最佳配置 (Gemini-3-Pro) 达到 64.0%。Adding a “scientist” sub-agent with optimized knowledge consolidation provides further gains of 7.5–14.0% absolute across all tiers, bringing the best configuration (Gemini-3-Pro) to 64.0%.

知识巩固。Knowledge Consolidation.事实证明，合并格式至关重要（表The consolidation format proves critical (Table2）。非结构化摘要所获得的收益还不到通过适当整合可实现的收益的一半。我们的结构化“声明-证明-约束-示例”格式（将调查结果记录为带有证据、约束和示例的类似法律的声明）达到了 64.0%，大大优于自由格式摘要的 58.0%（参见附录）). Unstructured summarization captures less than half the gain achievable with proper consolidation. Our structured “Claim-Proof-Constraints-Example” format—recording findings as law-like claims with evidence, constraints, and examples—achieves 64.0%, substantially outperforming free-form summaries at 58.0% (see AppendixH).

知识应用。Knowledge Application.剩余差距（36.0-57.0%）包括空间推理、代码生成和长视野上下文管理——我们的干预措施没有直接解决这些能力。这一差距与模型能力成反比，范围从 Gemini-3-Pro 的 36.0% 到 Qwen2.5-72B 的 57.0%。The residual gap (36.0–57.0%) encompasses spatial reasoning, code generation, and long-horizon context management—capabilities our interventions do not directly address. This gap scales inversely with model capability, ranging from 36.0% for Gemini-3-Pro to 57.0% for Qwen2.5-72B.

额外的结果。Additional Results.课程学习（L1Curriculum learning (L1→\rightarrowL5) 优于独立评估（附录L5) outperforms independent evaluation (AppendixE）。即使得到全力支持，也没有任何模型能够在第 5 级取得成功。). Even with full support, no model succeeds at Level 5.

定性故障分析。Qualitative Failure Analysis.

我们观察并总结了不同模型执行过程中的 12 种故障模式。这些故障模式分为三类，反映了我们的容量分解：We observed and summarized 12 failure modes from different models’ execution. These failure modes cluster into three categories that mirror our capacity decomposition:结构性故障structural failures（例如，反向中继器阻止信号传播）映射到知识应用差距；(e.g., reversed repeaters blocking signal propagation) map to the knowledge application gap;信号传播故障signal propagation failures（例如，没有放大的长串行路径）映射到发现差距；和(e.g., long serial paths without amplification) map to the discovery gap; and连线语义失败wire semantics failures（例如，方向连接不匹配）映射到识别间隙——最微妙的类别，产生的电路(e.g., directional connection mismatches) map to the identification gap—the most subtle class, producing circuits that看起来正确appear correct但功能上仍然存在缺陷。这种从明显错误到微妙错误的进展反映了我们定量结果中的能力差距层次结构。我们在（图yet remain functionally broken. This progression from obvious to subtle errors mirrors the capacity gap hierarchy in our quantitative results. We display one device illustration in (Figure4）。完整的分类法以及设备快照图位于附录中). The complete taxonomy along with device snapshot illustration is in AppendixI.

6.3 讨论Discussion

我们的结果表明，前沿模型的一般知识应用能力差距正在迅速缩小。知识识别差距开始变得相对主导。虽然一开始看到它的重要意义令人惊讶，但这一发现与爱因斯坦的观察相一致，即提出问题往往比解决问题更重要Our results show that the general knowledge application capability gap is rapidly shrinking for frontier models. The knowledge identification gap start to be comparatively dominating. While it is initially surprising to see its important significance, the finding aligns with Einstein’s observation that formulating a problem is often more essential than solving itEinstein & Infeld (1938)——提出有效的问题需要辨别哪些领域最有前途。实验发现差距也很明显：“科学家”代理遵循一个应该已经存在于 LLM 先验知识中的通用程序，但要求模型遵循正式的实验结构，结果为 0.33-1.00—posing effective questions demands discerning which areas are most promising. The experimental discovery gap is also notable: the “scientist” agent follows a generalized procedure that should already reside within LLM prior knowledge, yet requiring models to follow a formal experimental structure yields 0.33–1.00×\times收益，表明自主发现能力仍然不发达。此外，整合格式之间的明显差异表明，法学硕士在确定如何存储知识方面表现不佳。 “声明-证明-约束-示例”格式优于直观的“发现-解释-示例”格式，可能是因为描述声明成立的条件可以更好地理解何时应用它们，为记忆进化研究提供见解gains, suggesting autonomous discovery capabilities remain underdeveloped. Moreover, the stark differences among consolidation formats reveal that LLMs perform poorly at determining how to store knowledge. The “Claim-Proof-Constraints-Example” format outperforms the intuitive “Finding-Explanation-Example” format, likely because delineating conditions under which claims hold enables better understanding of when to apply them—offering insights for memory evolution research(Hu et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2025).

6.4 局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Work

首先，我们的结果反映了模型和编码剂支架的联合性能。我们相信这种组合合理地体现了当前通用的 LLM 代理能力，尽管它不应被视为上限。其次，虽然 Minecraft 环境提供了便利、高效、可控性和可扩展的难度，但它并没有涵盖现实世界发现的所有复杂性。因此，我们提出的任务应被视为一种诊断探针，用于评估科学发现和应用的复杂循环中的模型能力，而不是作为明确的基准。第三，我们的四向分解采用的干预措施的效果并不完全正交；因此，测得的差距应被解释为边际贡献和定量诊断信号，而不是孤立的能力测量。未来，我们将结合视觉输入来评估多模式能力。我们还计划支持底层环境动态的随机化，以防止基于记忆的解决方案。附录中提供了对这些限制和未来方向的详细讨论First, our results reflect the joint performance of the model and the coding agent scaffold. We believe this combination provides a reasonable representation of current general-purpose LLM agent capabilities, though it should not be regarded as an upper bound. Second, while the Minecraft environment offers convenience, efficiency, controllability, and scalable difficulty, it does not capture all the complexities of real-world discovery. Accordingly, our proposed tasks should be viewed as a diagnostic probe for assessing model capabilities across the complex loop of scientific discovery and application, rather than as a definitive benchmark. Third, our four-way decomposition employs interventions whose effects are not fully orthogonal; the measured gaps should therefore be interpreted as marginal contributions and quantitative diagnostic signals rather than isolated capacity measurements. In the future, We will incorporate vision input to assess multimodal capabilities. We also plan to support randomization of the underlying environment dynamics to prevent solutions based on memorization. A detailed discussion of these limitations and future directions is provided in AppendixB.

7 结论Conclusion

我们介绍We introduce科幻大师SciCrafter，一个基于 Minecraft 的基准测试，评估从发现到应用场景中的语言模型代理，即使是最好的模型也只能取得 26% 的成功。通过诊断干预，我们将绩效差距分解为知识差距识别、实验发现、知识巩固和知识应用。虽然大多数模型主要受到应用能力的限制，但前沿模型越来越受到知识差距识别的瓶颈，这表明主要挑战开始从, a Minecraft-based benchmark evaluating language model agents in discovery-to-application scenarios where even the best models achieve only 26% success. Using diagnostic interventions, we decompose performance gaps into knowledge gap identification, experimental discovery, knowledge consolidation, and knowledge application. While most models are primarily limited by application capacity, frontier models are increasingly bottlenecked by knowledge gap identification, indicating the main challenge starts to shift from正确解决问题solving problems right to 提出正确的问题raising right problems。我们发布. We release科幻大师SciCrafter作为评估不同代理架构的开放诊断测试台。as an open diagnostic testbed for evaluating diverse agent architectures.

附录BAppendix B局限性和未来的工作Limitations and Future Work

支架特异性。Scaffold specificity.

所有模型均通过单个通用代码代理支架（Claude Code）进行评估。我们选择这种设计是为了实现跨模型的可比性和可重复性，但这意味着我们的结果反映了模型和支架的联合性能，而不是当前法学硕士可以实现的上限。具有强大内存管理、结构化实验跟踪、检索先前发现以及精心设计的工具使用编排的专用代理堆栈可能会表现得更好。我们鼓励社区使用All models are evaluated through a single general-purpose code agent scaffold (Claude Code). We chose this design for cross-model comparability and reproducibility, but it means our results reflect the joint performance of model and scaffold rather than an upper bound on what current LLMs can achieve. A purpose-built agent stack with robust memory management, structured experiment tracking, retrieval over prior discoveries, and deliberate tool-use orchestration could plausibly perform better. We encourage the community to use科幻大师SciCrafter作为评估更强大的代理架构的测试平台；该基准测试基于 MCP 的界面使得在不同支架中的交换变得简单。as a testbed for evaluating stronger agent architectures; the benchmark’s MCP-based interface makes it straightforward to swap in different scaffolds.

合成环境。Synthetic environment.

虽然我们基于 Minecraft 的环境通过清晰的反馈和确定性机制隔离了核心发现到应用的挑战，但它仍然是合成的，可能无法捕获现实世界科学发现的所有复杂性，例如嘈杂的观察、模糊的反馈或开放式的假设空间。从这种设置中得出的结论应该被视为指示性的，而不是关于更广泛领域中代理能力的决定性的。While our Minecraft-based environment isolates core discovery-to-application challenges with clean feedback and deterministic mechanics, it remains synthetic and may not capture all complexities of real-world scientific discovery, such as noisy observations, ambiguous feedback, or open-ended hypothesis spaces. Conclusions drawn from this setting should be viewed as indicative rather than definitive about agent capabilities in broader domains.

分解混乱。Decomposition confounds.

我们的四向分解使用了预言机干预，其效果并不完全正交。例如，提示可以同时识别知识差距并提供促进探索的元认知线索；科学家子代理的好处可能部分源于鼓励实验，而不是其结构化模板。因此，测量到的差距最好被解释为不同支架干预措施的边际效用，而不是对孤立认知能力的清晰测量。Our four-way decomposition uses oracle interventions whose effects are not fully orthogonal. For instance, hints may simultaneously identify knowledge gaps and provide metacognitive cues that prompt exploration; the scientist sub-agent’s benefit may partly stem from encouraging experimentation at all rather than from its structured template. The measured gaps are therefore best interpreted as the marginal utility of different scaffolding interventions rather than as clean measurements of isolated cognitive capacities.

未来的工作。Future work.

我们计划在未来的工作中进行一些扩展。我们将结合视觉输入来评估多模式能力。我们的任务设计的一个显着特点是它为每个任务提供了配对的文本和视觉版本，使研究人员能够将多模态感知与推理能力分开。我们还计划支持底层环境动态的随机化，以防止基于记忆的解决方案。此外，我们计划评估其他代理架构，以更好地将支架效应与模型功能分开。We plan several extensions in future work. We will incorporate vision input to assess multimodal capabilities. A notable feature of our task design is that it provides paired textual and visual versions of each task, enabling researchers to disentangle multimodal perception from reasoning ability. We also plan to support randomization of the underlying environment dynamics to prevent solutions based on memorization. Moreover, we plan to evaluate additional agent architectures to better separate scaffold effects from model capabilities.

附录DAppendix D实验详情Experiment Details

代码代理框架Code Agent Framework

我们使用最先进的代码代理框架评估所有模型We evaluate all models using a state-of-the-art code agent framework(Dong et al., 2025; Google Cloud, 2025; Anthropic, 2025)。我们的任务需要持续的交互和复杂的推理，使得代码代理范例非常适合作为评估工具：它旨在与复杂的环境交互并通过可执行代码构建功能工件. Our tasks require sustained interaction and complex reasoning, making the code agent paradigm well-suited as an evaluation vehicle: it is designed to interface with complex environments and construct functional artifacts through executable code(Soni et al., 2025; Wang et al., 2024)，忠实地体现了当前前沿的人工智能能力。具体来说，我们使用克劳德代码, providing a faithful representation of current frontier AI capabilities. Specifically, we use Claude Code(Anthropic, 2025)，尽管我们的方法可以推广到其他代码代理。, though our method generalizes to other code agents.

选型Model Selection

我们的选择涵盖封闭和开源模型、前沿推理系统以及模型系列中的各种参数尺度：GPT-5.2、Claude-Opus-4.5、Gemini-3-Pro、Grok-4、GLM-4.7、Qwen3-235B-MoE、Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct 和 Qwen3-32B。通过交换底层 API 并同时保持所有其他组件固定来评估模型。Our selection spans closed- and open-source models, frontier reasoning systems, and various parameter scales within model families: GPT-5.2, Claude-Opus-4.5, Gemini-3-Pro, Grok-4, GLM-4.7, Qwen3-235B-MoE, Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct, and Qwen3-32B. Models are evaluated by swapping the underlying API while keeping all other components fixed.

验证试验Verification Trials

我们对每个任务执行 50 次验证试验的预算，作为标准化计算指标，避免模型架构中令牌计数的变化。验证试验包括代理触发机制（例如按下按钮）并观察后续的块状态转换。重要的是，环境仅返回原始状态更改，而不是来自评估脚本的成功信号；代理必须自主解释这些响应以评估功能。科学家子代理进行的所有试验都计入全球预算，迫使代理在探索和最终验证之间进行权衡。We enforce a budget of 50 verification trials per task as a normalized compute metric that sidesteps token-count variability across model architectures. A verification trial consists of the agent triggering a mechanism (e.g., pressing a button) and observing subsequent block-state transitions. Importantly, the environment returns only raw state changes, not success signals from the evaluation script; agents must autonomously interpret these responses to assess functionality. All trials conducted by the scientist sub-agent count toward this global budget, forcing agents to trade off between exploration and final validation.

评估协议Evaluation Protocol

模型在课程设置中进行评估：智能体从 L1 进步到 L5，发扬积累的经验。主要指标是成功率（已完成任务的百分比），是八次独立运行的平均值。独立（非课程）评估的结果在章节中报告Models are evaluated in a curriculum setting: agents progress from L1 to L5, carrying forward accumulated experience. The primary metric is success rate (percentage of tasks completed), averaged over eight independent runs. Results for independent (non-curriculum) evaluation are reported in SectionE.

附录EAppendix E更多实验结果More Experiment Results

我们在这里报告更多的实验结果。We report more experiment results here.

表中In Table6，我们在独立设置下报告结果，其中任务是独立解决的，而不是按照课程顺序（每个任务从 L1 到 L5）。虽然主要论文集中于课程设置（更好地反映模型的上限能力），但我们包含独立结果来检查模型在没有渐进式脚手架的情况下如何执行。结果表明，独立环境下的表现通常低于课程环境下的表现，这表明渐进式任务暴露有助于建立可转移到更困难挑战的知识。, we report results under the Independent setting, where tasks are solved independently rather than in curriculum order (L1 to L5 for each task). While the main paper centers on the Curriculum setting—which better reflects models’ upper-bound capacity—we include Independent results to examine how models perform without progressive scaffolding. As the results show, the performance under the independent setting is generally lower than under the curriculum setting, indicating that progressive task exposure helps build knowledge that transfers to harder challenges.

我们还单独报告了科学家子代理的结果（使用优化的知识整合结构），而没有提示。主论文报告了带有提示的模型和带有提示加上科学家子代理的模型之间的性能差异，确保所有差距总和为 100%。在这里，我们单独分离出科学家子代理的贡献。结果表明，单独使用它与将其与提示结合起来相比，可以获得相当的改进。例如，Gemini-3-Pro 从基线到 w/scientist 子代理提高了 9.0%，这比从 w/hint 到 w/hint+scientist 的 11.5% 提高小 2.5%。这表明预言机提示可以放大科学家子代理的有效性。We also reports results with the scientist sub-agent alone (using the optimized knowledge consolidation structure) without hints. The main paper reports the performance difference between models with hints and models with hints plus the scientist sub-agent, ensuring all gaps sum to 100%. Here, we isolate the contribution of the scientist sub-agent alone. The results show that it alone attains a comparable improvement to combining it with hints. For example Gemini-3-Pro improved 9.0% from baseline to w/scientist sub-agent, which is 2.5% smaller than the 11.5% improvement from w/hint to w/hint+scientist. This indicates that oracle hints can amplify the effectiveness of the scientist sub-agent.

表格Tables7通过through10按任务类型和难度级别提供 Gemini-3-Pro 性能的详细分类。我们在独立和课程设置下报告四种条件下的结果：基线、有提示、仅由科学家、以及提示加科学家。基线模型在 L4 上完全失败，但通过提示或科学家子代理，模型开始应对 L4 挑战。然而，没有一个在 L5 上取得成功，这对未来的模型来说是一个公开的挑战。我们还观察到任务 C 始终是最困难的，在所有条件下得分最低。这可能是因为它的顺序要求对精确的时空推理提出了更高的要求——这是当前语言模型的一个显着弱点。provide a detailed breakdown of Gemini-3-Pro’s performance by task type and difficulty level. We report results across four conditions—baseline, with hints, with scientist alone, and with hints plus scientist—under both Independent and Curriculum settings. The baseline model fails completely at L4, but with hints or the scientist sub-agent, models begin to tackle L4 challenges. However, none succeed at L5, leaving this as an open challenge for future models. We also observe that Task C is consistently the most difficult, achieving the lowest scores across all conditions. This may be because its sequential requirements pose greater demands on precise spatial-temporal reasoning—a notable weakness of current language models.

为我们的定量差距分解奠定基础（第To ground our quantitative gap decomposition (Section5.1）在具体代理行为中，我们构建了 32 灯同时激活任务（A 系列）的 12 个设备变体，每个变体都表现出不同的故障模式。 工作参考设备（Case W，32/32 灯亮起）用作基线。 这 12 个失败案例根据以下情况分为三类：) in concrete agent behavior, we constructed 12 device variants of the 32-lamp simultaneous activation task (Family A), each exhibiting a distinct failure mode. A working reference device (Case W, 32/32 lamps lit) serves as the baseline. The 12 failure cases are organized into three categories based on the舞台stage信号管道破裂，从电源一直延伸到灯。of the signal pipeline that breaks, progressing from the power source to the lamps.

一、1I.1代表性失败案例Representative Failure Cases

图Figure4显示了三个代表性案例：工作参考、结构故障（向后中继器）和信号传播故障（长蛇）。点亮的灯显得明亮；暗灯保持未亮状态。这些案例说明了智能体如何构建电路shows three representative cases: a working reference, a structural failure (backwards repeaters), and a signal propagation failure (long snake). Lit lamps appear bright; dark lamps remain unlit. These cases illustrate how agents can construct circuits that are拓扑上合理的topologically plausible还yet功能损坏functionally broken——如果不了解底层的红石机制，就很难诊断故障。—failures that are difficult to diagnose without understanding the underlying redstone mechanics.

一、2I.2失败分类Failure Taxonomy

这些故障自然地分为三类，与我们的容量分解一致：These failures naturally cluster into three categories that align with our capacity decomposition:

第一类：结构性故障。Category 1: Structural failures.

当智能体将方块放置在不正确的位置、使用错误的方向或忽略关键连接时，就会出现这些故障，从而导致物理结构本身被破坏的电路。 此类别主要映射到These failures arise when the agent places blocks at incorrect positions, uses wrong orientations, or omits critical connections—resulting in a circuit whose physical structure is itself broken. This category maps primarily to知识应用knowledge application能力：代理可能理解红石原理，但无法将其转化为正确的方块放置。capacity: the agent may understand redstone principles but fails to translate them into correct block placements.

    案例 9 — 向后中继器Case 9 — Backwards Repeaters（8/32 点亮）。四个中继器的输入侧朝向(8/32 lit). Four repeaters are placed with their input sides facing离开away从信号源。中继器是一种单向设备；反转它们的方向会产生障碍，阻止信号在每个轴上传播超过距离 4。from the signal source. Repeaters are one-way devices; reversing their orientation creates barriers that block signal propagation beyond distance 4 on each axis.

  • •

Transparent blocks cannot conduct redstone power, so the button press never enters the wire network despite all 112 wires and 32 lamps being correctly placed.

    情况 8 — 仅轴Case 8 — Axes Only（0/32 亮）。仅放置 4 根主轴线（总共 32 根线），没有分支线。信号沿着所有轴流动，但没有灯与任何轴线相邻——“最后一英里”传输完全缺失。(0/32 lit). Only the 4 main axis wires are placed (32 wires total) with no branch wires. Signal flows along all axes but no lamp is adjacent to any axis wire—the “last mile” delivery is entirely missing.

第 2 类：信号传播故障。Category 2: Signal propagation failures.

这些故障发生在结构连接的电路中，其中信号These failures occur in structurally connected circuits where the signal无法到达cannot reach由于电线覆盖不足或缺少放大而导致所有目标灯。 该类别映射到all target lamps due to insufficient wire coverage or missing amplification. This category maps to知识发现knowledge discovery容量：智能体尚未发现（或未能应用）15 块信号衰减规则。capacity: the agent has not discovered (or fails to apply) the 15-block signal decay rule.

    案例7——微小的核心Case 7 — Tiny Core（8/32 点亮）。仅 20 根电线（相对于工作装置中的 112 根）在每个方向延伸 3 个方块。最近的8盏灯亮起；其余 24 个不在电线范围内。(8/32 lit). Only 20 wires (vs. 112 in the working device) extend 3 blocks in each direction. The 8 nearest lamps light; the remaining 24 are beyond wire reach.

第 3 类：连线语义故障。Category 3: Wire semantics failures.

这些故障涉及结构完整且具有足够信号功率的电路，但由于代理不了解红石线的原因而失败These failures involve circuits that are structurally complete and carry sufficient signal power, yet fail because the agent does not understand redstone wire’s定向连接语义directional connection semantics-电线仅在其视觉连接的方向上为块提供动力。 该类别映射到—wire only powers blocks in the directions it visually connects to. This category maps to知识差距识别knowledge gap identification容量：代理甚至没有意识到电线方向性是一个相关因素，使其成为最微妙和最困难的故障类别。capacity: the agent does not even recognize that wire directionality is a relevant factor, making it the most subtle and difficult failure class.

  • •

    案例 3 — 平行线Case 3 — Parallel Lines（14/32 点亮）。七根平行的 N-S 线通过 E-W 干线连接。 N–S 线具有全功率，但仅连接南北，因此灯放置(14/32 lit). Seven parallel N–S wires connected by an E–W trunk. The N–S wires carry full power but only connect north and south, so lamps placed之间between线路（需要 E-W 电源）保持黑暗。lines (requiring E–W power) stay dark.

    案例 10 — 连接陷阱Case 10 — Connection Trap（20/32 点亮）。垂直于现有的死端分支添加 12 根额外的“陷阱”线，导致自动连接形成 L 形，从而重定向流量(20/32 lit). Twelve extra “trap” wires are added perpendicular to existing dead-end branches, causing auto-connection to form L-shapes that redirect flow离开away来自灯。添加电线from lamps. Adding wires休息breaks一个工作电路。a working circuit.

    案例12——指环Case 12 — The Ring（0/16 亮）。中心周围有一圈封闭的金属丝。每根环线都沿着环线连接到其两个相邻的环线，而不是向外连接。尽管自始至终都承载着 8-15 的功率，但向外部灯提供的功率却为零。(0/16 lit). A closed ring of wire surrounds the center. Every ring wire connects to its two neighbors along the ring—never outward. Despite carrying power 8–15 throughout, zero power is delivered to external lamps.

    案例2——岛屿Case 2 — Islands（16/32 点亮）。该电路包含三个石锚，但只有一个有按钮。两个“孤岛”集群与电源完全断开。该特工构建了看似合理的子电路，但与按钮没有任何电气连接。(16/32 lit). The circuit contains three stone anchors, but only one has a button. Two “island” clusters are completely disconnected from the power source. The agent built plausible-looking sub-circuits that have no electrical connection to the button.

    案例 11 — 死端钩Case 11 — Dead-End Hooks（12/20 点亮）。臂尖处的钩线改变了最后一根线的连接方向，切断了本来会点亮的灯的电源。死端的一根额外电线会反转接收电力的方向。(12/20 lit). Hook wires at arm tips change the last wire’s connection direction, cutting power to lamps that would otherwise be lit. A single extra wire at a dead end reverses which direction receives power.

I.3 总结Summary

表Table11总结了所有案例。 失败分类揭示了从明显的结构错误（类别 1）到微妙的语义误解（类别 3）的进展。 值得注意的是，3 类故障产生的电路summarizes all cases. The failure taxonomy reveals a progression from obvious structural errors (Category 1) to subtle semantic misunderstandings (Category 3). Notably, Category 3 failures produce circuits that看起来正确appear correct目视检查——电线已连接，电力流经网络，但灯仍保持暗状态。 这些案例表明，最难诊断的故障是代理的领域心理模型不正确的故障upon visual inspection—wires are connected, power flows through the network, yet lamps remain dark. These cases demonstrate that the hardest failures to diagnose are those where the agent’s mental model of the domain is质量上不完整qualitatively incomplete而不是数量上的不准确。 这种进展反映了我们在定量结果中观察到的能力差距层次结构：知识应用失败是最容易诊断的，而识别失败则需要最深入的领域理解。rather than quantitatively inaccurate. This progression mirrors the capacity gap hierarchy observed in our quantitative results: knowledge application failures are the most straightforward to diagnose, while identification failures require the deepest domain understanding.
